state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul` is reached: all six stages are on disk and every check in its record passes locally, except the CI floor on `main`.**

The whole site was read once against `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads* by five reviewers that did not write it. Every flagged passage was rewritten from its meaning: Guides, Syntax, Install, the Core reference index, In-Depth and the home page. Four sidebar labels changed with their page titles in `website/astro.config.ts`: "HTML is escaped for you", "Null is checked when you compile", "One request cannot change another" and "Where Novis is weaker". The URLs did not change.

Green in this session: every `bun nv site --check` part, `bun nv site --build`, `bun test tools/nv/test/site.test.ts` (18 pass), `bun nv verify` and `bun nv verify --doc`. `bun nv owners --closes website-overhaul` names no gap.

For the user's review before the branch lands: the six standout features on the home page (`website/src/content/docs/index.mdx`) are a proposal, and so are the four renamed titles above. `sponsoring.mdx`, `impressum.md` and `datenschutz.md` were not reviewed, because they are in the user's own voice.
